exposure: Position selected by women and routine nursing
Position management, manual rotation of the fetal position, and use of a U-shaped birth stool
cohort: 384 primiparous women with a fetus in a persistent occiput posterior position.
finding: Position management, manual rotation of the fetal position, and use of a U-shaped birth stool was associated with shorter labor duration, lower pain and blood loss 2 hours after delivery, and a lower episiotomy rate compared to routine care.
